metadata.description: Personal collection of GitHub Copilot CLI plugins/skills

plugins.name: cbse-unit-test-prep
plugins.description: Generates a detailed CBSE unit-test/exam study guide (chapter notes + CBSE-pattern Q&A, exported as DOCX and PDF) from a school exam timetable/portions circular. Covers CBSE Class XI/XII, any stream.

plugins.name: sof-olympiad-prep
plugins.description: Generates original SOF-style practice papers for Class 3 and Class 5 olympiads (IMO, IEO, ICSO): full mock tests and topic-wise practice sets with answer keys and OMR sheets as print-ready PDFs, plus marking, a separate score log for each child and weak-topic reports.
